description: Fork of exp575 (E=192, killed at step 6000 = 1.5754, projected final 1.53-1.56). Single coupled change: E 192->384 AND d_v 32->64. Keeps H*d_v=E invariant (6*64=384, out_proj stays square 384->384). No sparsification of NAP/tph — clean baseline at full vanilla-class E width. ln_emb gamma init bumped 0.1 -> 1/sqrt(E)=0.051 for matching logit-scale-at-init across E sweep (sqrt(E)*gamma_emb ~ 1.0). All else identical (no residual_lut, no Linear unembedder, separate LN_x/LN_emb tied dot head). Predicted: ~230M params (tok_emb +6.29, v_lut +23.6, out_proj +75.5 vs exp575). Predicted trunk bandwidth ~137 Mbits (still 2.5x cheaper than vanilla trunk's 340). Total bandwidth ~540 Mbits/tok (vs vanilla 742). Tests whether the LUT-LM minimal arch with vanilla-class E=384 can close the gap to tied vanilla 1.3882 — at iso-E the trunk-bandwidth-cheaper LUT backbone should be the only differentiator. Refs: exp575 projection 1.53-1.56 @124M, exp567 1.4768 @103M (untied full), exp328 1.3882 @23M (tied vanilla).
